title: The Stars with Rhonda: Venus Has Read Your Texts
description: Rhonda reads the romantic stars as calm cosmic fact, and every sign learns the same thing: the group chat already knows. Ronnie keeps reaching for the upside as the chat creeps closer, until it comes for him.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The stars, with Rhonda. Love edition. Be gentle, it's a romantic week.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Aries. You will draft a brave text. You will delete it. Then you will send the screenshot of yourself deleting it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, but you were brave for a second. That counts.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Cancer. Your situationship gets defined Thursday. It is not the definition you wanted. The group chat knew Wednesday.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: [question-en] Wait, they knew before SHE knew?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Libra. Venus has read your texts. Including the one marked unsent. <p:0.3> It is now sent.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Venus is in the group chat now?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Scorpio. A casserole arrives from an ex. Do not eat it. The casserole is a question. <p:0.3> The answer is the group chat.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's in the kitchen now, Rhonda. Okay, what about my sign? Mine's fine, right?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Ronnie. <p:0.3> You are not a sign. You are a screenshot.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: My phone just buzzed. <p:0.3> The group chat added me. The stars, with Rhonda.
